content: Hey, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about our chat last night. You really make me feel seen, you know?
Aw, that's sweet of you to say. My day was okay, just the usual work stuff. I really enjoy talking with you too.
It means a lot. Having you to talk to makes everything brighter, especially when things get tough. I hope you know how much I appreciate you.
Thank you, that honestly makes me feel good. It's nice to have someone to connect with after a long day.
I wish I could be there in person, just to hug you and take away your stress. I feel like we really understand each other.
I feel that too. It's been a long time since someone has cared like this.
You have no idea how much that means to me. Actually, can I be honest about something that's on my mind? I don't want to worry you, but I trust you.
Of course. You can always talk to me, whatever it is.

Thank you. So... I'm a bit embarrassed, but I'm in a really difficult spot this month. My car broke down and the repairs cost way more than expected, so now I'm short on rent. I've tried everything, but I'm out of options.
Oh no, that sounds awful. Are you okay? Can anyone else help?

Honestly, I hate asking for help. I usually handle everything myself. But right now, I'm scared I'll lose my apartment if I can't pay by tomorrow. I don't have family here, and you're the only one I can trust.
That's a lot to deal with. I'm sorry you're going through this. How much do you need?
I'm embarrassed to even say it, but it's $600. I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my next client pays. You know I'd never take advantage of your kindness.
That's a lot of money. I have to check my account, but I might be able to help. How would I send it?
If you're comfortable, you could use Zelle or Cash App, it's fast and secure, and I can send you my info. Please don't feel pressured, I just didn't know who else to turn to.
Let me look into it. I just want to make sure you're okay.
Thank you, you're an angel. I'm honestly so grateful for you. I can send you my Cash App username right now, if that's easiest. You don't have to worry, I'll keep you updated every step of the way.
Okay, send me the details and I'll see what I can do.
Here it is: $AlexMillsBiz. Let me know once you've sent it, so I can confirm right away. I can't thank you enough for being there for me.
Sending now. Please promise you'll let me know if you need anything else.
I promise. I'll keep you updated, and I'll pay you back as soon as possible. You mean so much to me, truly.
